analysis: Independent pre-treatment bulk-RNA direction check of frozen GSE120575 positive controls
data_transform: log2(FPKM + 1) per gene; program score is the mean within-cohort gene z-score.
interpretation_limit: Bulk direction check only: no inference about immune-cell identity, cell-state abundance, cell-cell interaction, causal mechanism, or clinical utility. This result is one cohort-level check and does not resolve participant-level dependence in matrix labels.
